verdict.rationale: Segment is a SaaS customer data platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Segment MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. The Public API, Profile API and the docs' 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude' links are adjacent building blocks or features, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
